parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `StopBehaviorTests.stopIsIdempotent` (line 214) and `StopBehaviorTests.playAfterStopWorks` (line 234) — carry `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.swift` in the `Playback` package. Although the Jaccard similarity is high (0.778), the two methods test distinct behavioral contracts: idempotency of stop versus the ability to resume playback after a stop.
